newsitem.title: USA: Ford buying lease cars from dealers - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Ford buying lease cars from dealers - NYT.

text.p: Ford Motor Co has begun paying dealers to buy cars coming off lease as a way to prevent used-car prices from dropping, the New York Times said.
In Tuesday's edition, the Times said Ford began the program on May 1, buying the vehicles from dealers who otherwise would return them to Ford for sale at auction.
Ford has begun paying dealers for each vehicles that is returned, as long as the dealers sell them on their own lots, rather than sending them back to Ford.
